title: Production Turnaround System
description: A four-image production-facing series that translates the same hero into clean turnaround, orthographic, and approval-sheet assets.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the technical character-sheet grammar for the same heroine. Images 02-04 preserve exact identity, costume breakdown, armor placement, and silhouette while changing sheet density and production purpose.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-turnaround-sheet first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-front-side-back-sheet, 03-equipment-callout-sheet, and 04-wiki-approval-layout. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
